# Source-reported default control bindings

Source: [Default Button Controls](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/2130); page edited 2024-04-13. Evidence: archived documentation; not independently game-verified.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/2130.md#wiki-2130) before using these values.

Normalized from the source image alt text; images themselves are not bundled. These describe defaults only, not a user's remapped controls.

Xbox trigger/bumper alt labels reuse PlayStation R1/R2/L1/L2 terminology; preserve the source labels as uncertain rather than invent corrected artwork. Interact has no exact key/button label in the source.

Button String is the appropriate runtime route when UI must follow the player's actual binding.

## Image alternative-text labels

| Workshop | Windows | Playstation | Xbox | Nintendo Switch |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary Fire | Left Mouse Click | Right Trigger (R2) | Right Trigger (R2) | Right Trigger |
| Secondary Fire | Right Mouse Click | Left Trigger (L2) | Left Trigger (L2) | Left Trigger |
| Ability 1 | Left Shift | Right Bumper (R1) | Right Bumper (R1) | Right Bumper |
| Ability 2 | E | Left Bumper (L1) | Left Bumper (L1) | Left Bumper |
| Ultimate | Q | Triangle | Y | X |
| Interact | Interact | Interact | Interact | Interact |
| Jump | Space | X | A | B |
| Crouch | Ctrl | Circle | B | A |
| Melee | V | Right-Stick Down | Right-Stick Down | Right-Stick Down |
| Reload | R | Square | X | Y |
